# FDG3032

> DO NOT use the same name for a namespace and a type in that namespace.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.4 Names of Namespaces.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1724
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

CA1724 reports type names that match a namespace name, including framework namespaces such as System.Data (see FDG3035).

## From the book

For example, do not use `Debug` as a namespace name and then also provide a class named `Debug` in the same namespace. Several compilers require such types to be fully qualified.

These guidelines cover general namespace naming guidelines, but the next section provides specific guidelines for certain special subnamespaces.
